recipes.name: Spiced Cranberry Apple Chutney Recipe
ingredients_raw: 3 tablespoons water, or more as needed
1 large Granny Smith apple - peeled, cored and chopped

steps.text: Combine cranberries, sugar, and water in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium; cook until cranberries have popped, 8 to 10 minutes. Stir in celery, apple, orange zest, orange juice, raisins, pecans, ginger, cloves, and salt; cook, stirring frequently, until celery is tender and sauce is reduced, about 35 minutes. Remove from the heat, cover the saucepan, and let chutney stand to thicken, about 15 minutes. Serve warm.

raw_recipe.headline: Spiced Cranberry Apple Chutney Recipe
raw_recipe.description: This spiced cranberry apple chutney recipe cooks cranberries, apples, golden raisins, and celery into a sweet, tangy chutney with orange zest and spices.

review.reviewBody: We had invited 7 people for Thanksgiving dinner and I made this Spiced Cranberry Chutney. Everyone just loved it and I had to write out the recipe a couple of times. Since then, I have made this recipe twice and I can say this is a "no-fault" recipe. Try it -- you'll love it!
I took your advice and cut the sugar in half - it was delicious, also left out the pecans to make it lower in fat.

This was excellent. I followed the recipe, but subbed out raisins for tart dried cherries, added a pear (it was on hand and needed using), some cardamom, and Chinese five spice. After reading the reviews, I doubled the batch - I'm so glad I did. I'm looking forward to serving this with brie and/or making as part of a charcuterie board. Its a very forgiving recipe and is pretty quick prep. Give it a try. I think your family members that don't like standard cranberry sauce will really like this.

Excellent sweet chutney. Almost finished cooking now, house smells amazing! Instead of cutting down sugar if you dont want it as sweet, simply add a little cranberry juice, or to be more like a true chutney add small amounts of apple cider vinegar towards the end of cooking to your preference. I add 1/4 cup red onion and a clove of garlic, also a little oriental 5 spice and cinnamon. about 4 or 5 good size oranges will give you the cup of juice and zest. Fresh ginger if possible. This is a delicious chutney recipe good for many uses, be creative! Going over brie stuffed chicken with prosciutto and wilted greens, yum!

I doubled the recipe for a large group but did not double the sugar based on other reviewers' comments. Also, I'm diabetic so used stevia along with a little Truvia brown sugar to sweeten, which worked well. It was delicious! I'll be making this again, thank you for the recipe!

I have been looking for a good cranberry recipe for years and this is definitely it! I made it last Thanksgiving and got two requests to make it again this year. I added cinnamon to really give it a Christmas taste and smell.
I decreased the sugar by 1/2 C . Be sure to increase this recipe by 1/2 or double it; everyone loved it!

This was good but would have been so much better without the orange zest and I wouldn't use 1/4 tsp of clove either (maybe half that) as both of these overpowered the flavor. It's like that was all you could taste and the flavor of the cranberries was very much down played. I would make this again with these changes and would add a can of mandarine oranges chopped in half then it would be perfect !!

Loved all the spicy flavor of this dish! I did follow others reviewers and cut the sugar in half. For me, it was perfectly sweet enough. My daughter could't get enough of this and she doesn't usually eat cranberry relish! This is excellent cold as well.
This is a great and easy recipe. Like others I reduced the sugar by half. I also added a bit of chopped Jalapeno pepper and cayenne to spice it up a tad.
My favorite. Used 12 oz (3 cups) cranberry and only 1 cup sugar bcz I like it a little tart. And I use whatever apple I have and don’t peel it.
Awesome recipe, something different that just plain cranberry sauce. Great on turkey burgers and with chicken strips.

Fantastic! Enjoyed every bite. Was even eating it out of the container with a spoon. Didn't change except no raisins. Everything else followed the recipe. So easy to make I made it again. It stores really well and I have portioned it out and have frozen it so that we can enjoy it at our leisure.

I have tried a lot of Cranberry Sauce, Relish and Chutney recipes and this is my favorite. I thought the celery sounded strange but its perfect... and the apple as well. This will be my go to Chutney. Thanks for sharing.

I grew up with Cranberry Sauce with Christmas dinner. Rather plain but I knew of nothing more. Throw in new levels of flavours and call it chutney and you have a great side for your Christmas dinner table. Try it.
Absolutely Delicious! My Husband loves this recipe! It’s an absolute staple for Thanksgiving in our home!
Been making it for years for Christmas dinner. Always a hit!

Loved this!!! Not everyone in my family like cranberries and I ended up with leftovers. I made this and WOW!!! it was fantastic! I ended up using as a sauce for pork and chicken. I also replaced my red pepper jelly with it and it was amazing with brie and crackers!

People that don’t like cranberries will love this! I use it to do a stuffed pork tenderloin for Christmas dinner turned out fabulous! The aroma it makes in your kitchen while preparing it makes your mouth water. Thanks for sharing ???
